notes: Refined dependencies to enforce correct build order (contract → logic → facade → tests/integration). No new stories created.

change_log.note: Core logic must depend on schema/contract
Facade depends on contract and core logic
Integration requires logic and facade completion

stories.title: Align Provider Search Models to Existing Shared Contract (No New Schema)
stories.description: Refactor provider_search_models to strictly reuse and align with existing shared contract (FIND-P-M1), ensuring no new schema definitions are introduced and all inputs/outputs conform to canonical structures.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Implement provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search (embeddings, scoring, ranking) with deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector confidence is below threshold.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via Find Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate provider_search_service into find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, location normalization, and search execution for tool routing.

stories.title: Extend Existing Provider Search Tests (No Duplicate Coverage)
stories.description: Extend existing provider search test suite to validate vector ranking thresholds, taxonomy fallback triggers, and edge cases without duplicating baseline coverage.

stories.title: Validate Integration with Embeddings and Provider Data Pipelines
stories.description: Validate end-to-end compatibility with embedding generation and provider data pipelines, ensuring correct vector indexing, data alignment, and search accuracy against loaded provider records.
